name: Vodka Soda
tagline: One spirit, cold soda, lime: the no-friction Indian bar order.
instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice. Add vodka and cold soda, stir once, and squeeze in the lime.

name: Whisky & Cola
tagline: The familiar two-part serve found at house parties and restaurant tables.
instructions: Pour whisky over ice, top with cola, and give it one gentle stir. Add lime if wanted.

name: Vodka Nimbu Soda
tagline: Vodka lengthened with the sweet-salt-sour logic of nimbu pani.
instructions: Add vodka, lemon, syrup and black salt to an ice-filled glass. Top with soda and stir well.

name: Whisky Soda Highball
tagline: India’s long-running whisky-and-soda order, built extra cold.
instructions: Pack a chilled highball with hard ice, add whisky, then pour soda slowly down the side. Stir once.

name: Rum & Limca Highball
tagline: Dark rum with the lemon-lime mixer common to Indian home bars.
instructions: Build over ice, squeeze the lime over the drink, and stir once.
videoSearch: rum lemon lime soda cocktail recipe

name: Vodka Guava Masala
tagline: The roadside guava-and-masala flavour pattern in an easy long drink.
instructions: Shake vodka, guava and lime with ice. Pour into an ice-filled glass and finish with masala, salt and optional chilli.

name: Adrak Whisky Highball
tagline: Whisky, ginger, honey and lemon in a lighter highball frame.
instructions: Muddle ginger gently with honey and lemon. Add whisky and ice, top with soda, and stir.

name: Picante
tagline: The spicy tequila serve that has become a contemporary Indian-menu default.
instructions: Muddle coriander and chilli lightly. Add tequila, lime, agave and ice; shake hard and double strain over fresh ice.

name: Guava Picante
tagline: A fruit-forward Picante using the guava, chilli and salt combination India already loves.
instructions: Shake everything with ice and double strain over fresh ice. Add a restrained black-salt rim.

name: Southern Curry Leaf Picante
tagline: A published reposado, chilli and curry-leaf variation.
instructions: Muddle chilli and curry leaves gently. Add the remaining ingredients and ice, shake, and double strain over fresh ice.

name: Cucumber Curry Leaf G&T
tagline: A cooling G and T with familiar South Indian aromatics.
instructions: Slap the curry leaves and add them to an ice-filled glass with gin and cucumber. Top with tonic and squeeze in lime.

name: Balle Balle Bloody Mary
tagline: A chaat-masala, chilli and coriander Bloody Mary published for Indian home bars.
instructions: Muddle chilli and coriander lightly. Add everything with ice and roll between two glasses several times; strain over fresh ice.

name: Filter Kaapi Martini
tagline: A South Indian filter-coffee nightcap in the Espresso Martini family.
instructions: Use freshly brewed, cooled filter coffee. Shake all ingredients very hard with ice and double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Imli Whisky Sour
tagline: Whisky Sour structure sharpened with the sweet-sour pull of tamarind.
instructions: Dry shake first if using aquafaba. Add ice, shake hard, and double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Aam Panna Vodka Cooler
tagline: The raw-mango summer cooler made bar-ready with vodka.
instructions: Add vodka and chilled aam panna to an ice-filled glass. Top with soda, stir, and garnish with slapped mint.

name: Kala Khatta Vodka Soda
tagline: Mumbai gola nostalgia, black salt and fizz.
instructions: Build vodka, syrup and lime over ice. Add soda, stir, and finish with black salt.

name: Jal-Jeera G&T
tagline: A savoury, cumin-led G and T that stays light and familiar.
instructions: Fill the glass with ice. Add gin and chilled jal-jeera, top with tonic, and stir once.

name: Mango Saffron Daiquiri
tagline: Mango, aged rum and saffron in a compact daiquiri.
instructions: Shake hard with ice and double strain into a chilled coupe. Use the jaggery only if the mango needs sweetness.

name: Curry Leaf Margarita
tagline: Pineapple and curry leaf brighten a Margarita base.
instructions: Muddle curry leaves gently, add the liquids and ice, shake, and double strain into a lightly salted chilled glass.

name: Paan Martini
tagline: Betel leaf and gulkand turn the after-dinner paan ritual into a short drink.
instructions: Muddle the betel leaves gently with gulkand. Add vodka, lime, rose water and ice; shake and double strain.

name: Thandai Rum Flip
tagline: A cannabis-free Holi thandai folded into a rich rum flip.
instructions: Dry shake with the pasteurised egg if using, then shake with ice. Double strain and grate a little nutmeg over the top.

name: Kokum Gin Sour
tagline: Konkan kokum gives a gin sour colour, acid and a gentle tannic edge.
instructions: Dry shake if using aquafaba. Shake again with ice and double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Jamun Gin Sour
tagline: Monsoon jamun, gin and black salt in a vivid sour.
instructions: Dry shake if using aquafaba, then shake with ice and double strain. Taste the jamun before adding all the syrup.

name: Khus Vodka Collins
tagline: Cooling vetiver sharbat stretched into a crisp Collins.
instructions: Shake vodka, khus and lemon with ice. Strain into an ice-filled glass, top with soda, and stir.

name: Ganne Ka Ras Vodka Cooler
tagline: Fresh sugarcane juice, cumin and lime with a clean vodka base.
instructions: Shake briefly with ice and strain over fresh ice. Use only freshly pressed, hygienically handled juice and serve immediately.

name: Tulsi Gin Smash
tagline: The garden-pot herb makes a natural Indian answer to a basil smash.
instructions: Muddle tulsi very lightly, shake with the remaining ingredients and ice, and double strain over fresh ice.

name: Elaichi Jaggery Old Fashioned
tagline: Whisky, gur and smoky cardamom: Indian pantry, classic proportions.
instructions: Crack the cardamom without crushing it to powder. Stir everything over ice, strain onto a large cube, and remove the pod.

name: Cold Brew Rum & Cacao
tagline: Dark rum, coffee and cacao for the less-sweet new-wave bar palate.
instructions: Shake briefly with ice and strain over one large cube. Reduce syrup if the cold brew is naturally sweet.
videoSearch: rum cold brew coffee cocktail recipe

name: Darjeeling Whisky Highball
tagline: Whisky and tea lengthened into a fragrant, low-sugar highball.
instructions: Chill the brewed tea completely. Build everything over ice, top with soda, and stir once.

name: Rasam Mary
tagline: Tomato, pepper and prepared rasam make a savoury South Indian brunch drink.
instructions: Add all ingredients with ice and roll between two glasses until cold. Strain over fresh ice and adjust salt only after tasting the rasam.

name: Solkadhi Gin Cooler
tagline: Kokum-coconut solkadhi becomes a creamy-tart coastal cooler.
instructions: Shake briefly with ice and strain over fresh ice. Use chilled, fresh solkadhi and serve immediately.

name: Kanji Tequila Highball
tagline: Fermented carrot kanji brings savoury acidity to an agave highball.
instructions: Build over ice and stir gently. Use a refrigerated, cleanly fermented kanji batch; discard it if smell, mould or pressure seems abnormal.

name: Kombucha Whisky Highball
tagline: Bottled ginger kombucha supplies acid, fizz and fermentation complexity.
instructions: Pour whisky over ice, top slowly with cold commercial kombucha, and squeeze in the lemon.

name: Urrak Lemonade & Chilli
tagline: Goa’s seasonal first-distil cashew spirit with Limca, lime and a split chilli.
instructions: Build over ice and stir once. Urrak strength varies: buy from a reliable licensed source and adjust the pour accordingly.

name: Tambde Roza
tagline: Cashew feni and brindao-style kokum in a bright Goan long drink.
instructions: Build over ice, top with soda and squeeze in lime. For a sweeter local-style version, replace half the soda with lemon-lime soda.

name: Feni Coconut Cooler
tagline: A minimal no-shaker Goan serve that lets cashew feni stay visible.
instructions: Add everything to a chilled glass, stir, and serve without ice or over one large cube.

name: Feni Guava Mary
tagline: Goan feni meets guava, chilli sauce, citrus and black salt.
instructions: Roll all ingredients with ice between two glasses and strain over fresh ice.

name: Mahua Lemonade Highball
tagline: Floral mahua spirit in the approachable lemonade-and-mint format.
instructions: Build over ice, top with tonic, and stir once. Use a licensed bottled mahua spirit, not unverified distillate.

name: Mahua Sour
tagline: A producer-published sour that keeps mahua at the centre.
instructions: Dry shake if using egg white, then shake hard with ice and double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Kerala Toddy Cooler
tagline: Fresh toddy, coconut, lime, pepper, cumin and curry leaf.
instructions: Shake briefly with ice and strain over fresh ice. Toddy changes quickly: use only fresh product from a reliable licensed source and serve immediately.

name: Arrack Coconut Old Fashioned
tagline: Coconut water and bitters soften arrack without hiding it.
instructions: Stir everything with ice until cold and strain over one large cube.

name: Kokum Curry Leaf Spritzer
tagline: Tart kokum, curry leaf and black salt in an adult zero-proof build.
instructions: Slap the curry leaves, add them with kokum and lime to an ice-filled glass, top with soda and stir.

name: Saffron Cardamom Fizz
tagline: Kesar and elaichi made bright rather than milky.
instructions: Make saffron water by steeping two threads in 40 ml hot water and chill it. Build everything over ice and stir.

name: Fennel Cold Brew Tonic
tagline: Coffee bitterness, saunf and tonic give this alcohol-free drink real length.
instructions: Build cold brew and fennel syrup over ice, top slowly with tonic, and garnish with star anise if wanted.

name: Haldi Ginger Highball
tagline: Turmeric, ginger, lime and soda with a dry pepper finish.
instructions: Shake syrup, ginger and lime with ice, strain into an ice-filled glass, top with soda and add pepper.

name: Anar Basil Shrub Soda
tagline: A tart pomegranate shrub gives the complexity usually supplied by alcohol.
instructions: Slap the basil and add it with shrub to an ice-filled glass. Top with soda and stir.

name: Kanji Spritz
tagline: North Indian carrot kanji becomes a savoury fermented spritz.
instructions: Build over ice and stir gently. Keep kanji refrigerated and discard any batch with mould, an off smell or abnormal pressure.

name: Darjeeling Ginger Fizz
tagline: Tea, honey, lime and ginger ale: familiar ingredients, grown-up balance.
instructions: Chill the tea completely. Build tea, honey and lime over ice, top with ginger ale, and stir once.

name: Guava Chilli Fizz
tagline: Guava-cart flavour with chilli, salt, lime and a clean soda finish.
instructions: Shake guava, lime, chilli and salt with ice. Strain over fresh ice, top with soda, and stir.

name: Jamun Apple Jalapeño Fizz
tagline: Jamun tartness, apple and a little green heat.
instructions: Shake everything but soda with ice, double strain over fresh ice, top with soda, and stir.

name: Rose Lychee Tonic
tagline: Rose and lychee kept crisp with lime and tonic.
instructions: Build over ice, top with tonic, and stir once. Rose water is potent; use drops, not a free pour.

name: Coconut Curry Leaf Fizz
tagline: Nariyal pani and curry leaf in a dry, coastal zero-proof cooler.
instructions: Slap the curry leaves, shake them with coconut water, lime, syrup and ice, strain over fresh ice, and top with soda.
